MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

2. Solve for x: x + 7 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 7

3. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

4. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

6. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

9. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 15
   C. 1
   D. 56

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 7
   C. 17
   D. 23

11. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 82

12. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 41

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

Final Answer: 36 m²
